samples.question: The distant gold START card shows a two-bit counter: the left lamp is the 2s bit and the right lamp is the 1s bit; dark means 1 and hollow means 0. Read the four command cards in row order, left to right then top to bottom. Cyan adds 1 and coral subtracts 1. Carry or borrow between the lamps, wrapping after 11 to 00 and before 00 to 11. What two-bit pattern remains: 00, 01, 10, or 11?
